scopeProvenance: Bounded engineering implementation authorized in parent-agent assignment; not a new human acceptance or launch decision.

behavior.values: Immutable exact-target command, canonical withdrawal ID, attributable receipt and derived lifecycle values exported only through RF public.py.
behavior.identity: Strict company/year/observation ID/version/fact hash and verified-user actor primitives. Nonblank reason is retained exactly, at most 1000 Unicode characters, valid UTF-8 without NUL. Request/receipt SHA-256 commitments use separate versioned domains.
behavior.time: Aware server time is normalized to UTC, preserving all six microsecond digits; withdrawal before original capture fails.
behavior.replay: Pure original-command comparison binds actor, scope, target and exact reason; it neither selects an idempotency key nor consults current evidence.
behavior.lifecycle: Supersession is derived before withdrawal. Withdrawn heads never reactivate ancestors. Duplicate/orphan/fork/invalid scope, hash, version or chronology and withdrawn ancestors fail. Independent new roots remain possible.
behavior.codec: Dedicated closed rf1086-register-observation-withdrawal-v1 JSON codec; bounded strict canonical UTF-8 parsing rejects duplicate/unknown fields, malformed primitives and altered commitments.
behavior.authority: Preparation validates a supplied exact target; lifecycle validates supplied history. Neither proves persistence, complete current history, accepted ownership or consequential permission. Future repositories must establish those facts under a held guard.
behavior.compatibility: No existing observation or archive codec v1-v4, persistence protocol, adapter, HTTP route/schema, generated client or web behavior changed.
